'''Ulis''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], working for the [[organization]] of the [[Oblee]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]]. Ulis eventually left Nirama's organization and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had became a member of the [[Believers]], a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] that was active in the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Ulis was among a team of Believers that were dispatched to the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] by [[Len Markus]], to prevent the [[Heroes of Cularin]] from destroying three [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] shards that were funneling power to the [[Darkstaff]], [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that was possessed by Markus.
